hero.sub: We sell the whole Apple range and hand it to you already set up — your data moved, your iCloud signed in, your screen protector on straight.
hero.caption: In the shop today

range.headline: Five things we know by heart.
range.body: We stock the current line and the model before it, because the model before it is often the better buy. Tell us what you do with the thing all day and we will point at one.

items.name: iPhone
items.line: The one you will hold for three years.
items.body: From the current Pro down to the model two years old. We will tell you which one you actually need, and it is usually not the most expensive.
items.alt: An iPhone face down on a dark surface, one hard light across the camera lenses

items.name: Mac
items.line: Laptops that outlast the job you bought them for.
items.body: MacBook Air and MacBook Pro, plus Mac mini for the desk. We will size the memory to what you open at once, not to the spec sheet.
items.alt: An open aluminium laptop glowing in a dim room

items.name: iPad
items.line: A screen for drawing, reading and the second monitor.
items.body: iPad, iPad Air and iPad Pro, with Apple Pencil and the keyboard cases. Come in and draw on one before you decide which tip you like.
items.alt: A tablet lying flat with a slim metal stylus beside it

items.name: Apple Watch
items.line: Sized on your wrist, not on a chart.
items.body: Series, SE and Ultra, with the bands in the drawer to try. We fit the band and pair it to your iPhone before you leave the counter.
items.alt: A smartwatch with a woven band standing on a dark stone block

items.name: AirPods
items.line: Listen to them here before you buy them.
items.body: AirPods, AirPods Pro and AirPods Max, with a tip-fit check so the seal is right. A bad seal is why people think the bass is missing.
items.alt: Two white wireless earbuds in an open charging case on a dark surface

service.headline: You leave with it working.
service.body: A new device is three hours of transferring, signing in and wondering which backup is the right one. We do that part at the counter while you wait.

items.title: Transfer your data
items.body: Messages, photos, apps and WhatsApp history moved from your old phone — Android included.

items.title: Sign in and secure
items.body: Apple Account, iCloud, two-factor and Find My switched on, with recovery written down for you.

items.title: Film and fit
items.body: Tempered glass applied dust-free, case fitted, band sized — on the counter while you watch.

items.title: Trade in the old one
items.body: We quote your old device on the counter, wipe it in front of you and take it off the price.

visit.headline: Come and hold one.
visit.body: Every model on this page is on the table, charged and unlocked. Ask about stock before you travel and we will put one aside for the day.
visit.note: Prices on this page are samples and change with the exchange rate. Ask for today's figure.
